links.outcome: Validity of citations generated by LLMs, assessed by expert review
links.effect: Citation analysis revealed frequent hallucinations, mostly critically erroneous; citation validity was independent of answer accuracy.
links.quote: Citation analysis revealed frequent hallucinations, mostly critically erroneous, and citation validity was independent of answer accuracy.

links.outcome: Calibration of model self-reported confidence against answer accuracy
links.effect: Confidence scores predicted accuracy, with strongest calibration in Individual Question mode.
links.quote: Confidence scores predicted accuracy, with the strongest calibration in Individual Question mode.

screen.reason: The study evaluates standard LLMs on a specialty medical/dental examination (AAP In-Service Examination) across various dimensions including accuracy, calibration, and citation hallucination without testing an operational deployment practice.
